label: B0_frame_only.json
config: BEFORE: Framer frame as framed (2 screws per joint), no lift parts, slings straight onto the floor rim chords at the same 8 points

meta.config: BEFORE: Framer frame as framed (2 screws per joint), no lift parts, slings straight onto the floor rim chords at the same 8 points

R1_rigid.label: Rigid lifting frame, 8 slings of exact equal length and no stretch

R4_equalised.label: Equalising rig (beam cascade): four equal sling forces on each side, sides by statics

R7a_outer_high.label: Equalising rig with 10 % skew (outer high): friction and geometry errors in the rig

R7b_inner_high.label: Equalising rig with 10 % skew (inner high): friction and geometry errors in the rig

R7c_one_end_high.label: Equalising rig with 10 % skew (one end high): friction and geometry errors in the rig

R7d_twist.label: Equalising rig with 10 % skew (twist): friction and geometry errors in the rig

R6_short_S1.label: Rigid frame with elastic slings, sling S1 short by 10 mm

R6_short_S2.label: Rigid frame with elastic slings, sling S2 short by 10 mm

R6_short_S3.label: Rigid frame with elastic slings, sling S3 short by 10 mm

R6_short_S4.label: Rigid frame with elastic slings, sling S4 short by 10 mm

R6_short_N1.label: Rigid frame with elastic slings, sling N1 short by 10 mm

R6_short_N2.label: Rigid frame with elastic slings, sling N2 short by 10 mm

R6_short_N3.label: Rigid frame with elastic slings, sling N3 short by 10 mm

R6_short_N4.label: Rigid frame with elastic slings, sling N4 short by 10 mm

L1_squeeze_y.label: Equalising rig, slings lean inwards across the module (5 % of the sling force sideways at every head)

L2_spread_y.label: Equalising rig, slings lean outwards across the module (5 % of the sling force sideways at every head)

L3_squeeze_x.label: Equalising rig, slings lean inwards along the module (5 % of the sling force sideways at every head)

L4_spread_x.label: Equalising rig, slings lean outwards along the module (5 % of the sling force sideways at every head)
